verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a Vue CLI is two older community comments praising 'vue-cli scaffolding' for project setup, which points to a first-party scaffolding CLI. The Tooling Guide and Quick Start items are bare titles and do not document any CLI. Nothing shows agent-oriented or scriptable CLI workflows. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an official CLI and its commands, evidence of AI-native or agentic CLI usage (non-interactive or scriptable modes), current independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: plus vue-cli scaffolding, make it easy to iterate on prototypes via single-file components with scoped CSS
